questions.question_text: What is a key takeaway from the Teen Goal-Setter Spotlights in Chapter 9?

options.text: Teens should only focus on academic goals to succeed
Setting SMART goals and breaking them into small steps can lead to big achievements
Success happens overnight without planning or effort
Only athletes can use goal setting effectivelyCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: How do top companies like Google use goal systems, as described in Chapter 9?

options.text: They avoid setting measurable goals to encourage creativity
They use systems like OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) to set ambitious goals and track progress
They focus only on short-term goals without long-term vision
They never adjust their goals, even when facing setbacksCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: What is a primary benefit of setting goals for college applications and interviews, according to Chapter 9?

options.text: It guarantees acceptance into any college without effort
It helps manage deadlines and stress while showcasing your strengths to admissions officers
It eliminates the need to prepare for interviews
It focuses only on writing essays and ignores other application componentsCorrect Answer: B

questions.question_text: What is a key lesson from the Community Impact section in Chapter 9 about setting goals to help others?

options.text: Community goals should only be pursued if they benefit you personally
Setting SMART goals for community projects can create measurable change and build leadership skills
Community impact goals are too complex for teens to achieve
You should avoid involving others when planning community initiativesCorrect Answer: B
